claims.assertion: Athena says local wars can begin over genuine disputes, though Cabal agents may manipulate both sides or install leaders favorable to it.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: She claims wars between Cabal-controlled powers are preplanned, with real combat and suffering arranged to control populations and extract human life energy.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: Her account distinguishes real suffering from fabricated motives and outcomes.

claims.assertion: Athena describes fear-fed entities as human-created egregores sustained by attention and suffering, which may dissolve when people stop focusing on them.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
